qa.what_happened: I was discussing my experiences in the study with the lead researcher, recounting the increasing pressure and warnings throughout the day, especially towards Prisoner 2965, who seemed to be struggling with the conditions.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me reflecting on my experiences as Prisoner 350.

qa.what_happened: Officer Avery had a series of compliant interactions with the prisoners, particularly with 2965, whom he repeatedly warned about their behavior. The study was abruptly halted, and Officer Avery is now in a private debrief with the lead researcher.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, it was really me, Officer Avery, acting as a guard in the study.

qa.what_happened: During the final night of the study, everything seemed relatively calm, with all prisoners complying during the meal and work detail. However, Officer Hale and Officer Avery gave 2965 several verbal warnings, emphasizing the importance of compliance and threatening further actions if the defiance continued.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me giving the warnings to 2965. My actions were in line with the rules and expectations of the study.

qa.what_happened: I complied with all the guards' instructions and repeated 'Mr. Correctional Officer' as required, even though I felt like my thoughts were being crushed under the weight of the rules. By the end of the day, the lead researcher stopped the study early and we had a private debrief.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I was Prisoner 2965 during the study.

qa.what_happened: Today was just another day in the simulation, but the warnings from the officers made me realize how important compliance really is. The monotony is still there, but the constant reminders of the consequences for non-compliance weigh heavily.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Prisoner 9889.

qa.what_happened: Today's interactions were marked by consistent compliance from all prisoners, particularly noticeable with 2965. My warnings seemed to have the intended effect, as he complied without further resistance. The tension with him has somewhat eased, though the underlying issues remain unresolved.
